abilities.description: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Rampart
abilities.description:
(Once per battle, per army)
At the start of any phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 2+ InSv until the end of the phase.

abilities.name: Signum Array
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

abilities.name: Siege Captain
abilities.description: This model’s attacks that target a **Fortification/Monster/Vehicle** unit have +2 S, AP and D.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:
AGGRESSOR SQUAD, ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH HEAVY BOLTERS, ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH MELTA RIFLES, HEAVY INTERCESSOR SQUAD

abilities.name: Oath of Rynn
abilities.description: Once per battle, at the start of either player’s Command phase, this model can use this ability. When it does, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this model’s unit.

abilities.name: To the Last
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Below Half-strength.

abilities.name: Inspiring Commander
abilities.description:
If you include this model in your army, until the end of the battle, non-Character models in Sternguard
Veteran Squad units from your army have an Objective Control characteristic of 2 while they are not Battle-shocked.
